title: Accounting Fundamentals
desc: Debits, credits, and how the three statements link. Do this before any modeling course. Free to enroll through Coursera.

title: Wharton Undergraduate Accounting Course Descriptions
desc: Not a certificate, a syllabus map. Use ACCT 1010 / 1020 / 2020 descriptions to sanity-check your course plan.

title: Bloomberg Market Concepts
desc: Economic indicators, currencies, fixed income, equities on live terminal data. Free through a school with a Bloomberg terminal using your .edu address.

title: Financial Markets
desc: Robert Shiller on risk, insurance, behavioral finance, and institutions. Audit free; pay only for the certificate.

title: Microsoft Learn: Excel and Power BI
desc: Free modules with hands-on labs. Aim at PL-300, Power BI Data Analyst. The exam costs money; the training does not.

title: J.P. Morgan job simulations
desc: Pick two that match your track. Investment Banking and Quantitative Research are the usual pair for analytics + finance.

title: Goldman Sachs job simulations
desc: Operations, Controllers, and Risk are the finance-adjacent ones. Controllers pairs well with the CFI accounting course.
